### 2. Geography Check 地理知识考查 (MCQ)

On which peninsula and along which river was the city of Rome originally founded?

罗马城最初建于哪个半岛以及哪条河流沿岸？

- [ ] **A.** Balkan Peninsula / Danube River（巴尔干半岛 / 多瑙河）
- [ ] **B.** Italian Peninsula / Tiber River（意大利半岛 / 台伯河）
- [ ] **C.** Iberian Peninsula / Tagus River（伊比利亚半岛 / 塔霍河）
- [ ] **D.** Anatolian Peninsula / Euphrates River（小亚细亚半岛 / 幼发拉底河）

## EXIT TICKET — Back 出场票（背面）

**"ANCIENT ROME — LESSON 2 · EXIT TICKET"**

### 1. Concept Check 核心概念检测 (MCQ)

Why were the {{< vocab "Twelve Tables" >}} (*Lex Duodecim Tabularum*) significant in Roman society?

为什么《十二铜表法》在古罗马社会中具有重要意义？

- [ ] **A.** They allowed the king to rule without any laws.（它们允许国王在没有任何法律约束的情况下统治。）
- [ ] **B.** They established written laws applying to all citizens.（它们确立了适用于所有公民的成文法。）
- [ ] **C.** They declared that only {{< vocab "patrician" text="patricians" >}} were allowed to hold property.（它们规定只有贵族才能拥有财产。）
- [ ] **D.** They were treaties signed with neighbouring tribes for peace.（它们是与邻近部落签署的和平条约。）

### 2. Key Takeaway 课堂收获

### Answer key 参考答案（仅供教师版使用）

**Entry ticket**

- **Q2: B** — the Italian Peninsula, along the Tiber River. (Usual distractor chosen: A, because students know rivers from Unit 1.)
- **Q3:** Consuls commanded the legions and could veto each other (1-year term) · Senate controlled the treasury and foreign treaties (~300 patricians for life) · Assemblies voted and elected tribunes, who used the veto to protect plebeians.
- **Q4:** {{< vocab "patrician" text="patricians" >}} (贵族) and {{< vocab "plebeian" text="plebeians" >}} (平民).

**Exit ticket**

- **Q1: B** — the Twelve Tables published the law in writing in the Forum. Push back gently on students who choose D: treaties existed, but "Lex Duodecim Tabularum" was a *lex*, a statute.
- **Bonus follow-up for fast finishers:** who got the 150 coins when an enslaved person's bone was broken? (The master — see your reading packet, Table VIII.)
- **Q3 look-for:** strong answers ask *why* Rome's own farmers were ruined by Rome's own victories.
:::
